hint: Drag the frame to move it, pull its handles to adjust it. With the keyboard: arrows move, Shift and arrows resize.

format.label: Format
format.jpegHint: The safest choice for a photograph. Anything transparent turns white.
format.webpHint: Lighter than JPEG at equal quality, and transparency is kept.
format.pngHint: Lossless, transparency kept. Far heavier on a photograph.

width.label: Width
width.hint: Beyond the width actually displayed, the file grows heavier without looking sharper.

weight.label: File size
weight.tooHeavy: The file exceeds the accepted size. Lower the quality or the width.

errors.unreadable: This file could not be read as an image.
errors.encoding: This file could not be prepared. Try another output format, or another image.
